subject: Fermi GRB 260523A: Global MASTER-Net observations report

MASTER-Kislovodsk robotic telescope  [1]  located in Russia (Lomonosov MSU, Kislovodsk Solar Station of Pulkovo observatory) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260523A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 44698) errorbox  26626 sec after notice time and 26682 sec after trigger time at 2026-05-23 23:30:53 UT, with upper limit up to  18.5 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 61 deg. The sun  altitude  is -17.4 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -33 deg., longitude l = 43 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3334230
